case.title: Device ids dev-k1 and dev-k10 are different devices despite sharing a prefix

submissions.open_text: Pipes burst near the market and our street had no water for three days.
The kiosk attendant closes early so evening queues spill onto the road.
Women walk past the clinic to reach the borehole because it is cleaner.
Prices from vendors double during drought months and we ration drinking water.

case.why: dev-k1 is used only by E01 (x, z) and dev-k10 only by P01 (y, y2), so each device has 1 contributor. A near-miss tempts a wrong implementation: matching device ids by prefix or substring (for example a SQL LIKE 'dev-k1%', or startswith) or after truncation would treat dev-k10 as dev-k1. That would count 2 contributors and fire on x. The other checks stay quiet: x is E01's only submission on 2024-06-03, its point is inside Kondele, the interview is daytime and 1530 s long, and its transcript is empty.
